$comment: What the issue of a value written into an HTML string says and offers, where the corpus, which holds whole messages, cannot: read by HoleAdviceTest.kt. A case lists every issue of its Kotlin source, sorted by start, end and code: its code, the text it marks, and the titles of its fixes in the order offered; says holds what the message must hold, ends what it must end with, and silent what it must not hold; notPreferred the titles an editor must not offer as the one to apply, and link the page the issue links to. coreHtml is false where the project's core has no Html (before 0.16.0), and constants names the const vals of the workspace the file does not declare. The source each fix leaves is in the corpus, kotlin-rewrite.json.
